summary: The solution employs a strong cross-validated ensemble of tree-based models and a custom neural network. However, it completely skips basic data cleaning. Furthermore, it contains a critical flaw in its feature engineering where conditional logic based on dataset minimums is applied independently to train and test sets, risking a fatal shape mismatch. Finally, applying rank normalization to test predictions renders the model incapable of single-instance inference.
